name: Wilkes Comic Con
blurb: An annual comic and pop-culture convention at The Stone Center in North Wilkesboro, North Carolina, with a cosplay contest and gaming room.

editions.evidence: Homepage banner: 'Wilkes Comic Con Returns Feb. 20, 2027 at The Stone Center in North Wilkesboro, NC'

notes: Only a single date (Feb. 20, 2027) is given anywhere on the site, with no second day stated, so this is recorded as a one-day event; nav items reference past multi-day photo galleries ('Photo Gallery – February 2026') so the con may historically run longer, but no second 2027 date is announced. The special-guests page for Feb 2027 shows only a 'Special Guest TBA' placeholder card, so guests is none-yet. Cover falls back to the site's generic 'comics.jpg' background since no edition-specific key art or og:image exists; the other large homepage images are a press-release screenshot, a small ad, and an unrelated Sonic the Hedgehog wallpaper/figure (apparently tied to an unrelated blog post), none usable as con key art.
